purpose: Immutable author-owned acceptance correction for four previously unpinned saved temporary-ban inventory behaviors. Consume these test-only changes unchanged in existing product PR #1853; do not open a standalone product PR.

previousManifest.scope: Immutable history of the original intended-RED evidence, registration-identity correction and restricted/publication pin corrections. Those historical runs are not execution evidence for this correction.

publicationPinFiles.scope: Unchanged: existing cfg(test) registry pins, 44 non-voice and 65 with-voice definitions.
Unchanged: 37 restricted BuiltinSlash rows, including Ban Members-class tempban-list; all denial and audit assertions retained.

registration.change: None: the existing test-only module registration discovers all eleven tests.

behaviorPinCorrection.pagination: The existing 24-row fixture must expose Next: /tempban-list page:2 and page:3 on the first two pages, with no end marker there. Its four-row final page must expose End of this saved page set and no next-page invocation. Existing complete identity, ten/ten/four row, repeat/default and write-probe assertions remain.
behaviorPinCorrection.timing: The October 2026 pending row must contain the separate due timing word and no future word; the 2099 pending row must contain the separate future timing word and no due word. Work-ID substrings and the header cannot satisfy these row-local assertions. The literal future timestamp assertion remains.
behaviorPinCorrection.replyBound: New runtime fixture reads ten long complete work IDs. Padding 85 produces 1898 UTF-16 units before the footer and 2032 including it at executionBase; padding 200 exceeds 2000 in the rows alone. Both must return a bounded cannot-fit refusal with an operator next action, no partial work/member IDs and no next-page claim. The shared private-answer helper independently enforces the 2000 UTF-16 limit on the actual REST payload.
behaviorPinCorrection.workOrder: Equal execute_at rows have opposing work/member IDs and permuted insertion order. The full cross-page sequence must be ascending work ID only; the former reverse/member-order alternative is removed. An earlier execute_at still outranks the tie key.
behaviorPinCorrection.ownership: Only the protected acceptance test and this manifest change. Production sources, authority/identity fences, schema, workflows, activation and unrelated tests are unchanged. Builder owns product integration, exact-head CI and re-review.

sensitivityTargets.expectedFailure: Page one has no Next: /tempban-list page:2.

sensitivityTargets.expectedFailure: The elapsed row lacks the due timing word.

sensitivityTargets.mutation: Replace execute_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS due with TRUE AS due.
sensitivityTargets.expectedFailure: The 2099 row lacks the future timing word.

sensitivityTargets.mutation: Replace execute_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS due with FALSE AS due.
sensitivityTargets.expectedFailure: The elapsed row lacks the due timing word.

sensitivityTargets.mutation: Disable the final output.encode_utf16().count() > 2000 condition after the footer, leaving the earlier per-row condition unchanged.
sensitivityTargets.expectedFailure: The padding-85 page sends more than 2000 UTF-16 units including framing. Disabling both guards is covered by the same fixture plus padding 200.

sensitivityTargets.mutation: Replace ORDER BY expiry.execute_at, request_id COLLATE C with the same order using user_id as the tie key, retaining the SQL quotes around C.
sensitivityTargets.expectedFailure: The tied work-ID sequence is reverse, not the required ascending work-ID sequence.

contract.command: /tempban-list [page:1..10000]; default page one; ten complete rows per page except the final page. Read-only ephemeral Ban Members-class moderation command, not a self/member lookup or reconciliation verb.
contract.states: Explicit due/future timing, pending, staged/prepared, running, quarantined and dispatch uncertain remain distinct; terminal history is excluded. Saved/due does not prove a Discord unban; running is not completion.
contract.order: Saved execute_at ascending, then work/request ID ascending in PostgreSQL C collation, never member-ID or insertion order. Complete work and member IDs stay associated on each row.
contract.privacy: Fresh actor authority, configured guild/moderation and registration/invocation fences, one ephemeral mention-suppressed bounded reply, no reasons/claim capabilities/raw errors/foreign data, no Discord ban lookup.
contract.spies: Real runtime/router/store, captured authority GETs and private REST reply, executed SQLx queries with at most eleven returned rows, five-ledger snapshots and nontransactional write probes, plus the unchanged independent read-only-pool control.
contract.limits: No concurrent-snapshot promise, 100000-row load claim or PostgreSQL scan-cost bound. Page-10000 deep lookahead, exact percent-roundtrip and subsecond-order supplements remain outside this correction. No production/staging tests or live actions.
